crossRefs.note: You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “Have you killed and also taken possession?” ’ You shall speak to him…
The dogs will eat he who dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field.”
The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.
“When this people, or the prophet, or a priest, asks you, saying, ‘What is the message from Yahweh?’ Then you shall…
A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
A revelation, Yahweh’s word to Israel by Malachi.
For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Bidkar
people.line: Officer of Jehu who witnessed Ahab's judgment

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A city in Issachar, associated with Ahab and Jezebel

people.name: Naboth
people.line: Jezreelite vineyard owner, unjustly killed by Ahab and Jezebel.

translations.web: Then Jehu said to Bidkar his captain, “Pick him up, and throw him in the plot of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite; for remember how, when you and I rode together after Ahab his father, Yahweh laid this burden on him:
translations.bsb: And Jehu said to Bidkar his officer, “Pick him up and throw him into the field of Naboth the Jezreelite. For remember that when you and I were riding together behind his father Ahab, the LORD lifted up this burden against him:
translations.kjv: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him;
